title: The Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: SHN -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> SHN

ai_review.summary: A sweet, solid set runs breezily but piano and Brent’s keyboard mic issues keep the soundboard recording from being great.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a relaxed, well‑executed run of songs that the band breezes through with ease. The soundboard source captures the performance, yet listeners note an over‑miked piano and distorted keyboards that detract from an otherwise fine tape. Security hassles at the venue also color some reviewers’ experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (2.75) combined with positive comments on the performance but consistent complaints about piano/keyboards and recording logistics yields a middling overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Piano is over‑mic'd, Brent Mydland's keyboards sound distorted; otherwise the tape is acceptable. Reviewers also mention security interference during taping.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a sweet, solid run of songs that the band breezes through with ease.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keys are distorted and piano is overly mic'd.
